Name: Earthy Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE)
Author: SeaSea50
Description:
[center][/center]
[center][img]https://i.ibb.co/ZxMrNps/mod-details-1.png[/img]

It's finally here! It only took a million years!

This mod retextures [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿'s buildings, furniture, trees and additional tilesheets to match [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy recolour[/url]﻿.

The whole mod is configurable using the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ so you can enable/disable certain tilesheet edits to your liking.

Pairs nicely with my two other SVE retexture mods: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25746]Grandpa's Shed Recolour[/url]﻿ & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28419]SVE Buildings Recolour[/url]﻿.



Some other mods I recommend as well:

N3cro92's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21788]DaisyNiko's Earthy Map for SVE[/url]﻿ - recolours the SVE Maps

 Morghoula's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28798]SVE Trees Recolored[/url]﻿ - for an alternative SVE tree look﻿ (you can turn off my recolour in the config

Suneohair's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28272]Unofficial SVE 1.15 Tree - Earthy Recolour Patch[/url]﻿ - for another option of earthy SVE trees
﻿

Thank you Flashshifter and the rest of the SVE team for the open asset use permission. Checkout the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Main Mod[/url]﻿!

Can't forget to thank ConcernedApe for making Stardew Valley[/center]
